items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Benny was a very good man. Benny for a long time was in a small group. I forget the name of the group.

ctx.x: And then -- oh then there was a period in '68 and '69 when Benny Green was the fourth trombone.
Right. Yes. Benny was there. Gee, you remind me of so many things.
How did you happen to get a fourth trombone?
